A FEW THINGS YOU MAY BE WONDERING

Little questions.
Helpful answers.

Which programmes are available? +

We currently offer Pre-Nursery (2+ years), Nursery (3+), LKG (4+), UKG (5+) and Daycare. Higher classes are planned progressively, subject to enrolment, infrastructure and required permissions.

What are the preschool and daycare timings? +

Regular preschool hours are approximately 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Daycare is available from 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM.

Can we visit before deciding on admission? +

Yes. We encourage families to visit the campus, experience the environment and discuss their child's needs with our admission counsellor before registration. You can find our address and directions below.
